feed.title: Daylight: Ordinance items: Montgomery County Commission and Clarksville City Council
feed.subtitle: Each item the Ordinance type rule matches, at each meeting it appears at. Daylight is an independent, unofficial site run by gnoshcodes. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City of Clarksville, Montgomery County, the Clarksville-Montgomery County School System (CMCSS), or the Clarksville-Montgomery County Regional Planning Commission. The official record held by each body controls.
